primary_task: Find an existing evaluation in the list and open its report, or start a new one.

not_exercised.reason: commits and leaves this screen; covered in the New-evaluation round

not_exercised.reason: out of scope for round 1 — this round is the evaluations list and shell

controls.label: E-mail
controls.after_interaction: accepts text; empty submit puts "E-mail address is required" under this field

controls.label: Password
controls.after_interaction: accepts text; empty submit puts "Password is required" under this field

controls.label: Sign in
controls.after_interaction: empty submit is refused and shows 2 field-level messages; the screen does not change

controls.label: Forgot your password?
controls.after_interaction: href="#", preventDefault — goes nowhere, no message

controls.label: Impressum / Dokumente / Kontaktdaten / Support
controls.after_interaction: carry an open-in-new icon; click does nothing — no target, no message

controls.label: Q-Explorer
controls.after_interaction: opens a menu with 2 destinations: Evaluations, Scheduled Reports; reports aria-expanded

controls.label: Startseite / Q.Reports / Fotoalbum / Q-Messungen
controls.after_interaction: rendered at 75% opacity; click does nothing — they are out of scope for this prototype but look enabled

controls.label: EN / DE
controls.after_interaction: options EN/DE; picking DE re-renders the page ("Evaluations" -> "Auswertungen") and switching back returns to English (true). Default is English, matching the vanilla.

controls.label: Log out
controls.after_interaction: returns to the login screen immediately — no confirmation

controls.label: bar itself
controls.after_interaction: position:fixed; stays in place while the page scrolls

controls.label: Status
controls.after_interaction: options: In Progress, Done, Failed (no "All" entry — empty means all). Picking one cut the list 28 -> 5 rows. A clear X appears inside the field.

controls.label: Status clear X
controls.after_interaction: restores all 28 rows and the X disappears

controls.label: Period
controls.after_interaction: options: Last 7 days, Current month, Last month, Last year, Other. Picking one cut the list 28 -> 4 rows.

controls.label: Clear filters
controls.after_interaction: appears only while a filter is set (true); clears all three and then removes itself

controls.label: Search
controls.after_interaction: filters by name as you type; no match shows "No evaluations found"; the X restores the list

controls.label: Type section header (6)
controls.after_interaction: headers: expand_morePunctuality DPM6 Evaluations | expand_moreRaw Data Export DPM4 Evaluations | expand_moreLine Analysis DPM4 Evaluations | expand_moreData Quality Index (DQI) DPM4 Evaluations | expand_moreConnection Punctuality5 Evaluations | expand_moreTrip Failures DPM5 Evaluations. Collapsing hid its rows (28 -> 22); chevron rotates; aria-expanded flips; header stays clickable. All six start expanded.

controls.label: Columns
controls.after_interaction: Name | Period | Created | Status | Actions | Name | Period | Created | Status | Actions | Name | Period | Created | Status | Actions | Name | Period | Created | Status | Actions | Name | Period | Created | Status | Actions | Name | Period | Created | Status | Actions. Headers are not sortable and give no sort affordance.

controls.label: Evaluation name
controls.after_interaction: plain text, not a link — the report is reached only through the row preview action

controls.label: Preview (eye)
controls.after_interaction: opens the report for that evaluation. Present only on DONE rows, and never on Line Analysis rows. Action sets per status:group — {"in_progress:punctuality":"delete","done:punctuality":"visibility+delete","failed:punctuality":"delete","done:raw_data":"download+delete","running:raw_data":"delete","done:line_analysis":"delete","failed:line_analysis":"delete","failed:data_quality":"delete","done:data_quality":"visibility+delete","in_progress:data_quality":"delete","done:connection":"visibility+delete","running:connection":"delete","failed:connection":"delete","done:trip_failures":"delete","in_progress:trip_failures":"delete"}

controls.label: Download
controls.after_interaction: on done Raw Data Export rows instead of preview; shows a snackbar "Download started …". No file is produced.

controls.label: Delete
controls.after_interaction: opens a confirmation ("Delete this evaluation?The evaluation and its result will be removed from the list. You can undo this for a few seconds afterwards.CancelDelete"); list untouched while open (true); confirming removes the row (28 -> 27); an undo snackbar appears (true) and undo restores it (true). Present on EVERY row including failed and in-progress ones.

controls.label: Count subtitle
controls.after_interaction: reads "<n> evaluations" and follows the filters

controls.label: + New Evaluation
controls.after_interaction: opens the full-screen New evaluation page with a breadcrumb back to Evaluations and Run in the corner; Run starts disabled (true)
